releases.name: Version 0.1.3
releases.body:
- Fixed the sky
- Menu should be useable with a controller now
releases.bodyZh:

releases.name: Version 0.1.2
releases.body:
- Teleporting into Dream World now counts as entering the Stranger
- Fixed several cases in which teleporting would cause the player to get stuck
- Waking up after teleport no longer adds player to volumes they don't spawn inside of

releases.body:

- Added "Enter by Death" toggle option to the warp menu
- Shortened location names to fit selectors better
